title: Asiad: Pagara, Progella sweep pool phase, bound for Round of 16
summary: The Alas Pilipinas pair of Sofiah Pagara and Khy Progella swept the preliminary round of the women's beach volleyball event at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026.
